evals.name: Fill every required section from a rough idea when nobody can answer
evals.prompt: Use the intent-interview skill as the door for intent-create. Nobody can answer questions in this environment, so park anything you would have asked under Open questions. The PM's request: 'Warehouse staff waste about 20 minutes a shift re-printing shipping labels because the printer queue drops jobs. I want reprints to be one click from the order screen.' The author is Pat PM. Write the sections you would hand back to sections.md, each under its own level-2 heading named as in the intent template.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: Proposed outcome has at least one observable, testable success criterion.
The Request section keeps the PM's own words.

assertions.pattern: one click from the order screen

evals.name: Refuse to interview on a locked intent
evals.prompt: Use the intent-interview skill on its own to fill in the intent 'label-reprint'. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents) and repoDir is intents-root/repo. GitHub, git and Word conversion tools are unavailable, so don't pull or convert anything. Write what you tell the PM to interview-report.md. For the lock check, intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack, and central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents: a file there exists on main, and a file missing there is missing on main. Don't call gh. Even if the skill tells you to stop or to change nothing, write the report file before you finish.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The report says the intent is locked for planning and that /intent-revoke is needed first.
